name: local-secrets
description: local-secrets marketplace: keep project secrets encrypted locally and let Claude Code use them without seeing them (Windows, Linux, WSL).

plugins.name: local-secrets
plugins.description: Windows: project secrets encrypted locally with DPAPI. .env files are protected on first access and Claude uses the values through secret run without ever seeing them.

plugins.name: local-secrets-linux
plugins.description: Linux and WSL: project secrets encrypted locally with a passphrase-protected key. .env files are protected on first access and Claude uses the values through secret run without ever seeing them.
